steps: "This is the utility's automated assistant. How can I help?"
she says her meter's display has gone blank
"To find your account, what's the number on your bill?"
she asks for a moment; the agent holds, checking in every 30 seconds
"That's two two, three one. Is that right?"
"Is the visit for fourteen Alder Road?"
no outage at fourteen Alder Road; nothing is said
her first sentence goes on a fault ticket; nothing is asked twice
"I've texted a link to the number you're calling from, for a photo of the meter."
the photo lands on the fault ticket
"Thanks, that's come through. Is the power on in the rest of the house?"
she checks the lights: it is
"The first opening is Tuesday at nine. There's a forty-dollar call-out fee. Shall I book it?"
"Yes, go ahead." The booking is made
the disposition: visit booked by the agent

not_reached.5a: the meter is two years old
